limitations.text: This file contains only audited first-batch source rows and is not a complete mirror of the CAPeSaRo hospital dashboard feed.
The provider-point builder may consume only explicit providerId/sourceCode pairs from this file; this does not enable automated fuzzy matching across CAPeSaRo names.
CAPeSaRo is a public government dashboard, but no explicit reuse license is recorded in this source file. Downstream users should retain source URL, retrieval date and this limitation.
